label: Bible Study
prompt: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, _____ not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
verse: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
note: Three verses before the eagles' wings — the God who never gets tired gives strength to those who do.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But after that the _____ and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
verse: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
note: Paul tells Titus that God's kindness and love appeared in person — in our Saviour.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Howbeit the hair of his head began to _____ again after he was shaven.
verse: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven.
note: One quiet verse of hope: in the prison house, Samson's hair began to grow again.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to _____ in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
verse: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
note: Paul's battle plan has a humble finish line: when you've done everything you can, stand.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be _____.
verse: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
note: Paul's one-line parenting rule: don't provoke your children, 'lest they be discouraged.'
